name: OMathMatCol
description: Represents a matrix column. The OMathMatCol is a member of the OMathMatCols collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathMatCol object.

properties.name: Args
properties.description: Returns an OMathArgs object that represents the arguments in a matrix column. Read-only.

properties.name: ColIndex
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the ordinal position of a column within the collection of columns in a matrix. Read-only.

properties.name: Align
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdOMathHorizAlignType constant that represents the horizontal alignment for arguments in a matrix column. Read/write.
